title: SillyTavern
summary: Character-chat frontend with character cards, chat export/import and world information; inferencing requires user-selected local or remote backend.
documentation_observations: Official docs describe character cards and chat history export as JSONL, which can be re-imported.
Plain TXT exports lose metadata; cloud transmission and behavior depend on backend/configuration.
limitations: Official documentation reviewed, but not installed or benchmarked by NaughtyBoddy. Low-refusal behavior, actual quality, privacy, performance and current release availability are not proven.
